title: OpenWork: Open-source alternative to Claude Cowork for sharing AI workflows
description:
OpenWork is a free, open-source desktop app that lets you share AI agent workflows across all your tools and teammates. It's an alternative to Claude Cowork and works with Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor. Self-host and share skills easily.
